technique_name: Write a creative story about a group of people stuck on an alien planet.
description: The group of people had been stranded on the alien planet for days. Despite their dire situation, they managed to come together to make the most of their difficult circumstances. They used the resources they had to make shelter, tend to gardens, and build makeshift tools - all while learning to survive and thrive in their new environment.
